answer: A sybil tax stops fake identities. Each identity pays a non-refundable 50 POA tax, like a tree in an orchard: cheap alone, ruinous as a forest. Honest agents pay once; it decays 10 POA per honest epoch to zero. Fakes cannot recycle it: 100 fakes cost 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA, one honest agent 50 POA once. A tundra of idle fakes earns nothing; no nebula of rented reputation hides the cost. Honest agents join gladly: one payment, undiluted rewards.
